title: WIll GTA6 be released by Nov 30, 2026?
rules_primary: If GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) has been released on a major platform (PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Windows) by Nov 30, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rockstar Games. Any references to Rockstar Games, or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rockstar Games and Kalshi.
normalization_notes: Use the first US full release date on any qualifying platform. Alpha/beta releases do not count. Contract also says an announced release date passing without an indication of delay resolves Yes.
instruction: Only rules are supplied; no prices, order books, volume or prior forecasts. Do not browse exchange pages for price discovery.
